title: Police cleared in shooting of man who killed his son
article: Two Brantford police officers have been cleared after fatally shooting a man who stabbed his son to death. Ontario's Special Investigations Unit says the officers were justified in shooting a knife-wielding Andrew Osidacz on March 18 inside the home of his estranged wife.
The incident started at a townhouse where officers found his eight-year-old son, Jared, dead and a woman and a girl injured. CP
